name: epfo_authenticate_member
description: Authenticates an EPFO member using UAN and credentials to initiate a session. This tool must be called before ALL other EPFO tools and returns a session_token required for subsequent operations. It does NOT perform any EPFO service like checking balance or submitting claims.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

password.description: Password associated with the EPFO member portal

otp.description: One-time password sent to the registered mobile number for authentication

name: epfo_check_kyc_status
description: Retrieves the KYC status of Aadhaar, PAN, and bank account for an EPFO member. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member and before epfo_raise_withdrawal_claim. It does NOT update or complete KYC details.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

name: epfo_complete_kyc
description: Submits or updates KYC details such as Aadhaar, PAN, or bank account for an EPFO member. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member. It does NOT retrieve KYC status.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

kyc_document_type.description: Type of KYC document to be updated

document_number.description: Document number for the selected KYC type

name: epfo_get_pf_balance
description: Fetches the current PF balance of the EPFO member. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member. It does NOT provide detailed transaction history like passbook.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

name: epfo_view_passbook
description: Provides detailed transaction history of the EPFO member's PF account. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member. It does NOT return only the summary balance.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

name: epfo_get_service_history
description: Retrieves employment/service history of the EPFO member across employers. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member and before epfo_transfer_pf_account. It does NOT initiate PF transfer.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

name: epfo_update_date_of_exit
description: Updates the date of exit from the last employer for an EPFO member. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member and before epfo_raise_withdrawal_claim for Form_19 settlement. It does NOT process withdrawal claims.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

date_of_exit.description: Date of exit from the last employer in YYYY-MM-DD format

name: epfo_raise_withdrawal_claim
description: Submits a withdrawal claim for PF or pension using specified form type. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member, epfo_check_kyc_status, and epfo_update_date_of_exit (for Form_19). It does NOT track claim status.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

withdrawal_reason.description: Reason for withdrawal (applicable only for Form_31)

name: epfo_track_claim_status
description: Tracks the status of a submitted EPFO withdrawal claim. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member and before epfo_raise_grievance. It does NOT raise new claims.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier of the withdrawal claim

name: epfo_transfer_pf_account
description: Transfers PF balance from a previous employer to the current employer account. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member and epfo_get_service_history. It does NOT retrieve service history itself.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

name: epfo_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance related to EPFO services such as claim delay or KYC mismatch. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member and epfo_track_claim_status. It does NOT track grievance status.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.

name: epfo_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks the status of a previously raised EPFO grievance. Must be called after epfo_authenticate_member. It does NOT raise new grievances.

uan.description: 12-digit Universal Account Number of the EPFO member

session_token.description: Token returned by epfo_authenticate_member. Required for all tools except epfo_authenticate_member itself.
